description: This is a PHP source file for the legacy dispatcher component of the Goteo web application. It processes incoming HTTP requests by parsing URL segments, determining the appropriate controller and method to invoke, and executing it accordingly. It handles routing logic, reflection to invoke methods dynamically, and output rendering or response handling.
